# Foundation Consumer Healthcare Appoints Rupa Bahri as CEO, Refocuses on Women’s Health

August 7, 2026

3 min read

Foundation Consumer Healthcare Appoints Rupa Bahri as CEO, Refocuses on Women’s Health

## What to know

## Listen to this article

Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH) has appointed Rupa Bahri as its new chief executive officer, marking a significant strategic transformation for the company. This leadership change follows FCH’s successful divestiture of its over-the-counter (OTC) wellness brands in June 2026. The move establishes FCH as a dedicated leader focused entirely on the women’s health sector. [...] Bahri’s appointment culminates FCH’s efforts to streamline its portfolio and sharpen its focus on the high-growth women’s health market. She expressed honor in joining FCH at a “transformative time,” recognizing the opportunity to build an exceptional platform around its iconic brand, Plan B. The company views women’s health as a dynamic and crucial area within healthcare.

Greg Bradley, who co-founded FCH and served as CEO since 2014, will transition to chairman of the board. During his 12-year tenure, Bradley scaled FCH from a startup to a top-10 OTC healthcare company, overseeing its recent strategic portfolio optimization.

PITTSBURGH — Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH) has named Greg Bradley president and chief executive officer. [...] The move comes as Foundation Consumer Healthcare has completed its $675 million acquisition of Plan B One-Step and two value emergency contraceptive brands from Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd.

Greg Bradley

“As the No. 1 OB/GYN-recommended O-T-C emergency contraceptive brand and an important birth control option for women across the United States, Plan B One-Step is the perfect addition to our growing portfolio,” Bradley said. “We look forward to devoting immense resources to support Plan B One-Step and working closely with our retail partners to ensure continued access to this critical women’s health product.” [...] Plan B One-Step joins a portfolio of differentiated O-T-C drug products at FCH that includes  Neo-Synephrine, Campho Phenique, Bronkaid, St. Joseph Aspirin and Theravent. The company said it sees a bright future ahead for itself and its retail partners, given its increased investment and category growth, its  commitment to innovation and interest in additional acquisitions.

At FCH, Bradley joins a team of industry veterans with nearly 80 years of collective experience in the development, marketing and commercialization of prescription and O-T-C medicines at leading companies. They include chief financial officer May Petracco, chief marketing officer Steve Howard, director of marketing Tara Evans and senior vice president of supply chain operations Doug Lusby.

About

Foundation Consumer Healthcare, based in the US, specializes in the development and manufacturing of over-the-counter healthcare products to enhance consumer well-being, focusing on accessibility and convenience in health solutions. Foundation Consumer Healthcare, established in 2014 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, US, is dedicated to the production of essential OTC healthcare products. The company was acquired by Kelso & Company in November 2017, with financial terms undisclosed. The current CEO is Gregory Bradley. [...] Foundation Consumer Healthcare focuses on the development and manufacturing of a diverse portfolio of over-the-counter (OTC) healthcare products designed to enhance consumer well-being. Their core product offerings include emergency contraception, particularly the Plan B One-Step® 1. 5 mg levonorgestrel, which serves to prevent pregnancy after unprotected intercourse and has been pivotal in providing consumers with timely reproductive health solutions. These products cater to a broad client base, including retailers, healthcare providers, and directly to consumers, ensuring accessibility and convenience of use. [...] Foundation Consumer Healthcare's products are distributed across various geographical markets, including but not limited to the United States, where they aim to address the urgent needs of consumers seeking accessible healthcare solutions. Foundation Consumer Healthcare generates revenue primarily through partnerships with retailers and wholesalers, who distribute their products to end consumers. Transactions typically occur on a B2B basis, where retailers purchase large quantities of products for resale, ensuring that the end users have ready access to these essential OTC healthcare items. Their flagship product, Plan B One-Step®, is a key driver of their revenue model, with pricing structures aligned with industry standards for similar OTC products.

## Mission & Vision

Formed in 2014, Foundation Consumer Healthcare is dedicated to improving consumers’ lives by developing and growing a portfolio of differentiated over-the-counter (OTC) products. Foundation’s management team includes industry experts, entrepreneurs and innovators with unmatched experience in the development, marketing and commercialization of prescription and non-prescription medicines. Our organization is financed by two established private equity funds, both with a successful history in the OTC marketplace and a solid commitment to building a diverse portfolio of brands under the Foundation banner. Foundation is based in Pittsburgh, PA, with additional team members located throughout the country.

### Greg Bradley | President and CEO

Greg joined Foundation Consumer Healthcare as CEO in October of 2017. Greg has 34 years of experience in the consumer-packaged goods industry with a specific expertise in OTC Healthcare. He has a proven track record in Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain and General Management.

Prior to joining Foundation CH, Greg spent much of his career with GlaxoSmithKline Consumer Healthcare (GSK) in senior management roles where he helped create several mega brands within the OTC healthcare landscape, including multiple Rx-OTC switches.

In 2011, Greg founded Advantage Consumer Healthcare (ACH), a full-service company specializing in OTC switches, Healthcare product launches and improving in-market performance of existing OTC Healthcare brands. [...] ### Jordana Barish | V.P. - OTC Brands

Jordana Barish is an accomplished marketing executive with 20+ years of experience across the consumer health, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. At Foundation Consumer Healthcare, Jordana leads the OTC and Wellness portfolio which includes Breathe Right, Dimetapp and Anbesol.

### Canaccord Genuity Advises Foundation Consumer Healthcare on the $1.045 Billion Divestiture of Breathe Right® and Other Consumer Health Brands to Prestige Consumer Healthcare [...] Canaccord Genuity is pleased to announce it acted as exclusive financial advisor to Foundation Consumer Healthcare (“Foundation”), a portfolio company of Kelso & Company (“Kelso”) and Juggernaut Capital Partners (“Juggernaut”), on the announced sale of an iconic portfolio of over-the-counter consumer health brands to Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. (NYSE: PBH) for an enterprise value of $1.045 billion. The portfolio, anchored by Breathe Right® Nasal Strips, the #1 brand synonymous with the nasal strip category, also includes Children’s Dimetapp®, the #1 most trusted children’s cough and cold brand among pharmacists, Anbesol®, a leading brand in oral pain relief, and seven other trusted consumer health brands. Collectively, the brands generate approximately $200 million in annual revenue [...] Under Foundation, the Breathe Right brand has established itself as the global leader in drug-free nasal strips, serving multiple consumer “better breathing” needs across sleep wellness, snoring, athletic performance, allergy relief, congestion relief and more. The sale enables Foundation, the portfolio company owned by Kelso and Juggernaut, to sharpen its focus on the continued growth of its Women’s Health business, anchored by its flagship Plan B One-Step® emergency contraception brand.

The deal marks Canaccord Genuity's second transaction with Foundation, having previously advised on the acquisition of Plan B One-Step® from Teva Pharmaceutical Industries in 2017 (as Sawaya Partners), and underscores the firm's deep commitment to the Health & Wellness sector.
